"""A complete DyUI app that shows the `list` component.

Save it as app.py, then run:  dyui run app.py
"""
import dyui
from dyui import ui

app = dyui.App(title="List demo", starters=["Show me"], persist=False)


@app.on_message
async def reply(msg: dyui.Message, chat: dyui.Chat):
    yield "Here is the `list` component."
    yield ui.List(ui.ListItem("Hotel Avenida", "4.6 ★ · $180/night", action="pick_hotel"))


@app.on_action("pick_hotel")
async def on_pick_hotel(action: dyui.Action, chat: dyui.Chat):
    # action.values holds what the user entered or chose; action.data is the static data
    yield f"Got `{action.name}` from **{action.label}** with values `{action.values}`."

components.name: html
components.description: Developer-authored HTML rendered in a sandboxed iframe.
components.details: The browser renders it in `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" srcdoc=...>` without same-origin access. Pass inline `html` source, or a `template` file plus `props`. Template files are looked up in `templates/` and then the folder itself, first in `template_root` if given, else in your app's directory and the current directory; only `.html` files inside those folders can be read (see `dyui.html.load_template`). In the template, `{{ key }}` is HTML-escaped and `{{{ key }}}` is inserted raw. Never produced by the LLM.
